headline: PM assures full support for garment sector, orders swift action
summary: Prime Minister Muhammad Yunus has formed a committee to resolve the issues facing the textile and garment industry.
details: Prime Minister Muhammad Yunus has assured the garment sector of the government's full support to overcome current challenges.
To ensure a swift resolution to the industry's problems, the Prime Minister has ordered the formation of a specialized committee.
The move comes as the textile and garment sector remains a critical pillar of Bangladesh's economy, requiring urgent policy interventions.
The Prime Minister emphasized the need for swift action to stabilize the industry and protect the interests of stakeholders.
caption:
The garment sector is getting a boost. Prime Minister Muhammad Yunus has ordered swift action to resolve industry issues.

Prime Minister Muhammad Yunus has assured the garment sector of the government's full support to overcome current challenges.

The move comes as the textile and garment sector remains a critical pillar of Bangladesh's economy, requiring urgent policy interventions.

The Prime Minister emphasized the need for swift action to stabilize the industry and protect the interests of stakeholders.
